raw.body:
## Summary

Addresses part of #37005, which flagged structural duplication across the codebase. The largest single finding was in `compiler/packages/snap/src/minimize.ts`: 30 generator functions used by `yarn snap minimize` for test case reduction, nearly all following one of two shapes:

- Remove one item at a time from a node's collection (statements, call arguments, function params, array/object elements, JSX attributes/children, destructuring pattern elements)
- Replace a matching node with one of its child fields (conditionals, if/while/for/try statements, binary/logical/member expressions, etc)

This PR extracts two generic helpers, `removeCollectionItems` and `simplifyByReplacement`, and rewrites the applicable generators in terms of them. No behavior change is intended; this is a pure internal refactor of a dev tooling script (not part of the shipped compiler or runtime).

- File size: about 2300 lines down to about 1320 lines
- `simplificationStrategies` list, `minimize`, and `minimizeRustDelta` are unchanged
- A few generators with genuinely distinct behavior (`simplifyCallExpressions`, `simplifySwitchStatements`, `simplifySingleStatementBlocks`, the identifier renaming generators, `simplifyVariableDeclarations`) were left as is since deduplicating them further would reduce clarity for little gain

## Test plan

- [x] `tsc --noEmit` passes for `packages/snap`
- [x] `yarn workspace snap build` succeeds
- [x] Ran `yarn snap minimize` against a hand crafted fixture with unused variables, extra statements, and a `for await` loop causing a known compiler error; verified it still reduces to a minimal repro that preserves the original error, matching pre-refactor behavior
raw.title: [compiler] Deduplicate simplification strategies in snap minimize.ts
